lines.speaker: foyer
lines.text: Thanks for calling the workshop. I'm the digital assistant. This call is recorded for quality. How can I help?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Hi, my boiler's stopped heating the water. Could someone come out and take a look this week?

lines.speaker: foyer
lines.text: Sorry to hear that. Let me check availability. There's Wednesday at ten thirty in the morning. Or Thursday at three in the afternoon. Would either suit you?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Thursday at three, please. Actually, sorry, could we do Friday morning instead?

lines.speaker: foyer
lines.text: Of course. Friday the eighteenth of September at ten in the morning is available. Does that work?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Yes, that's better. Thank you.

lines.speaker: foyer
lines.text: Can I take your full name, please?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Aidan Walsh.

lines.speaker: foyer
lines.text: Thanks, Aidan. And a contact number?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: It's zero seven seven zero zero, nine zero zero, one two three.

lines.speaker: foyer
lines.text: Let me read that back. Zero seven seven zero zero; nine zero zero; one two three. Is that right?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Yes, that's right.

lines.speaker: foyer
lines.text: And what's the address for the visit?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: It's fourteen Example Street, Manchester.

lines.speaker: foyer
lines.text: Let me read that back. Fourteen Example Street, Manchester. Is that right?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Yes, that's right.

lines.speaker: foyer
lines.text: Would you prefer your visit confirmation by email or text?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: By text, please.

lines.speaker: foyer
lines.text: You're booked for Friday the eighteenth of September, at ten in the morning. Your confirmation text will include the engineer's estimated arrival window and how to reschedule. Is there anything else you need?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: No, that's everything. Thanks.

lines.speaker: foyer
lines.text: You're welcome, Aidan. Take care.
